claims.text: Integrating machine learning with DFT can improve the accuracy of transition-temperature determination relative to existing experimental and computational methods.
Integrating machine learning with DFT can improve the accuracy of fusion-enthalpy determination.
Integrating machine learning with DFT can improve the accuracy of fusion-entropy determination.
Integrating machine learning with DFT can improve the accuracy of volume-change determination at the solid-to-fluid transition.
Integrating machine learning with DFT can improve the accuracy of dense-fluid heat-capacity determination.
The target materials are multicomponent high-entropy alloys that have a solid state.
The intervention is intended for high-temperature states around the solid-to-fluid transition.
Configurational entropy mediates the effect of the integrated machine-learning–DFT intervention on transition-property determination.
Mixing enthalpy mediates the effect of the integrated machine-learning–DFT intervention on transition-property determination.
Gibbs free energy mediates the effect of the integrated machine-learning–DFT intervention on transition-property determination.
Machine-learning methods can accelerate screening of the large composition space of high-entropy or multiprincipal-element alloys.
Machine learning can identify composition-related patterns in high-entropy-alloy data.
DFT provides accurate thermodynamic properties for the relevant solid and dense-fluid high-temperature states.
Combining machine learning with DFT yields a better understanding of the solid-to-fluid transition and its thermodynamic properties.
TOR-TILD and DFT free-energy studies are relevant existing computational baselines for this comparison.
The proposed approach is applicable to high-entropy alloys containing five or more principal elements.
Performance depends on machine-learning and DFT accuracy, training-data quality, and the complexity of the high-entropy system.
Failure to achieve improved accuracy against experimental values and existing computational methods would falsify the hypothesis.
